hints: The sugar went into the water, and the beaker never left the scale. Did the number on the scale go down?

Dissolving breaks the sugar into bits far too small to see. They spread out between the bits of water. Think of a crowd leaving a stadium and spreading through a city. You can't spot them any more, but nobody has vanished. The sugar still weighs the same.
Try 50 g of sugar. If dissolved sugar vanished, the scale would drop by 50 g. Watch what it really does.
